appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDesc: Choose the app theme. “System” follows your OS and updates live.
appearance.languageDesc: Choose the app's display language. Switches immediately, no restart needed.
appearance.languageReviewNotice: Machine-translated draft — not yet reviewed by a human speaker.
appearance.clockFormatDesc: Used by the calendar's hourly view.
appearance.fontSizeDesc: Applies to note and quick-note content in the editor.
appearance.dyslexiaFont: Use a dyslexia-friendly font (OpenDyslexic) in the editor
appearance.showModifiedOnHover: Show last-modified date when hovering a note

dictionaries.title: Dictionaries
dictionaries.description: Enable spellcheck languages and manage words you've added.
dictionaries.noCustomWords: No custom words yet — add them from the editor's right-click menu.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Save a compressed .zip snapshot of the whole vault (excluding the rebuildable search/graph cache) to a folder outside the vault.

import.title: Import
import.description: Bring notes in from another app. Always imports into a new, empty vault — your currently open vault is never touched or merged into.

maintenance.vaultCleanupDesc: Delete every note with an empty body to tidy up notes you started but never wrote in. Notes containing images, tables, or other non-text blocks are kept, even if they have no text. This cannot be undone.
maintenance.unusedAttachmentsDesc: Remove image, video, and file attachments that no note, template, or quick note uses anymore — left behind when you delete an embed or a note. Attachments still referenced anywhere are always kept. This cannot be undone.

keybindings.conflict: Conflicts with another shortcut on the same keys.

search_inNote.label: Find in note
search_inNote.description: Search for text within the open note

inspector_toggle.label: Toggle info panel
inspector_toggle.description: Show or hide the info panel (note metadata, or graph stats in the graph view)

note_new.label: New note
note_new.description: Create a new note in the current folder

view_quicknotes.label: Open quick notes
view_quicknotes.description: Switch to the quick notes view

nav_back.label: Back
nav_back.description: Go back to the previously visited note or view

nav_forward.label: Forward
nav_forward.description: Go forward to the next note or view in history

link_create.label: Link to note
link_create.description: Turn the selected text into a link to another note

template_use.label: Use template
template_use.description: Insert a saved template into the open note

graph.title: Graph
graph.empty: No links yet — connect notes with [[links]] to see them here.

calendar.linkNote: Link a note to this day
calendar.deleteRepeatingPrompt: This event repeats. Delete only this day, or the whole series?

home.title: Home
home.noWidgets: No widgets — turn on Customize to add one.
home.allWidgetsAdded: Every widget is already on your dashboard.

quickCapture.title: Quick capture
quickCapture.description: Jot a thought into Quick notes

miniGraph.title: Graph
miniGraph.description: A preview of your link graph
miniGraph.empty: No links yet — connect notes with [[links]].

home.pinnedEmpty: No pinned notes. Pin one from its editor (the pin icon).
home.searchPlaceholder: Search notes…  (#tag to search by tag)
home.searchTypeToSearch: Type to search…  Start with # to search by tag.
home.quickCapturePlaceholder: Capture a quick thought — it lands in Quick notes…

quicknotes.title: Quick notes
quicknotes.subtitle: A scratchpad for fast capture — jot ideas here, then move them into notes.

vaultSwitcher.title: Vaults
vaultSwitcher.chooseOrCreateFolder: Choose or create a folder for the new vault
vaultSwitcher.removeFromList: Remove from this list (keeps the vault's files on disk)

tags.title: Tags
tags.empty: No tags yet — add tags to a note from its info panel.
tags.selectTagPrompt: Select a tag to see the notes carrying it.

templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create one here, or save any note as a template from its editor.
templates.chooseToInsert: Choose a template to insert into this note
templates.emptyPicker: No templates. Create one with “Save as template” in a note’s header, or in Settings ▸ Templates.
templates.saveDescription: Creates a reusable template from this note's current content. It won't appear in your notes tree, search, or graph.

kanban.title: Kanban
kanban.searchForNote: Search for a note to place in this column.
kanban.everyNoteOnBoard: Every note is already on this board.
kanban.tagNotesCheckbox: Tag notes with this row's name (#{{tag}})
kanban.tagHint: When on, a note dragged into this row gains the #{{tag}} tag and loses it when moved out. Leave off for a plain row (like open/closed).
kanban.deleteBoardDesc: The board and its columns are removed. Your notes and their tags are not deleted.
kanban.deleteColumnDesc: The column is removed and its cards drop off the board. Your notes and their tags are not deleted.

errors.vault: No vault is currently open, or the folder isn't a usable vault.
errors.notFound: That note couldn't be found — it may have been moved or deleted.
errors.schemaTooNew: This file was saved by a newer version of Tundra (format {{found}}, this build supports up to {{supported}}). Update the app to open it.
errors.io: A file system error occurred. Check that the vault folder is accessible.
errors.serde: This file appears to be corrupted or malformed and couldn't be read.
errors.emptyBlockId: Internal error: a block was missing its id.
